title: Icarus Digital Marketing: Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer
description: Headquarters: United States URL: https://icarusdigitalmarketing.com/ Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer Remote | Full time | Paid 30-day working trial Icarus Digital Marketing builds and scales direct-response ecommerce brands, including brands in difficult and restricted categories. We are hiring a hands-on performance creative operator to work directly with the owners on our internal portfolio of brands. This is not a conventional graphic-design role. We need someone who understands why Meta ads convert and can personally turn that understanding into high-quality static and video creative using current AI production tools. You may come from dropshipping, affiliate marketing, DTC, a performance agency, or a creative media-buying background. We care more about commercial judgment, production ability, speed, and proof of work than polished credentials. The work You will use and help improve our internal Creative Cockpit. It takes a brand from research and foundational strategy through campaign creation, production, review, and delivery. For each brand, the system holds brand assets and voice, customer language and audience psychology, pains and desires, necessary beliefs, competitor intelligence, awareness levels, angles, hooks, offer context, prior creative, winners, and performance signals. Your job is to turn that intelligence into creative that can sell. • Read campaign briefs, audience research, voice-of-customer material, and brand strategy documents. • Decide what each batch should test and why. • Source and analyse strong visual and structural references. • Develop angles, hooks, scripts, concepts, storyboards, and landing-page direction. • Personally produce static ads and short-form video ads. • Use AI image, video, voice, and editing tools at a high level. • Create meaningful variants without producing repetitive AI slop. • Review work for persuasion, visual quality, brand fit, platform fit, and compliance. • Refine weak generations rather than accepting the first output. • Package approved assets for launch and document what each concept tests. • Read results and use the learning to plan the next batch. What you must be good at • Direct-response advertising and Meta creative strategy • Audience psychology and voice-of-customer interpretation • Awareness levels, hooks, angles, mechanisms, objections, offers, and message-market fit • Understanding when an ad should lead to a PDP, advertorial, listicle, quiz, or sales page • Static ad, UGC, and short-form video production • Visual-reference analysis and controlled recreation • Current AI image and video workflows using tools such as Seedance, Google Flow/Omni, Nano Banana/Gemini, GPT Image, Higgsfield, Kling, Sora, Veo, or comparable tools • Editing, compositing, pacing, captions, sound, and final polish • Fast, organised batch production • Reading creative performance and choosing the next test You are probably not right for this role if • Your portfolio is mostly branding, organic social content, or attractive design without performance context. • You call every asset “scroll-stopping” but cannot explain the audience belief or conversion mechanism. • You are a strategist who depends on other people to make the work. • You are a tool operator who needs someone else to provide every hook, angle, script, and decision. • You use one prompt, accept the first output, and call it AI production. • You cannot show exactly what you personally contributed to portfolio examples. • You dislike volume, iteration, testing, or direct feedback. What success looks like Within 30 days, you can understand our strategy packs and operating system, take a structured brief from research to finished assets with limited supervision, produce a useful weekly mix of static and video concepts, explain the reason for every important decision, maintain quality while moving quickly, and suggest practical improvements to the workflow. Compensation The role begins with a fully paid 30-day working trial at USD $2,000 . If the fit is strong, it becomes a long-term full-time position expected to pay USD $2,000 to $3,000 per month , based on demonstrated level, with additional performance upside available for an exceptional long-term operator. We care about ability, English comprehension, reliability, some overlap with our working hours, and quality of output. How to apply Do not send a generic cover letter. Message Simon on WhatsApp at +353 86 349 5073 and begin with: I make the work. • Send three Meta ads you personally made or materially directed. • For each example, state exactly what you did and explain the audience, angle, hook, and intended next step in the funnel. • Share any useful performance context you are permitted to disclose. Redacted evidence is acceptable. • Show one weak or failed creative and explain what you learned or changed. • List the AI tools you use in real production and explain your normal workflow from reference to finished asset. • Send a Loom of no more than five minutes. Choose one Meta ad you respect, explain why it works, and describe the next three variants you would test. • State your location, timezone, availability, and expected monthly compensation after the trial. Applications without the requested evidence will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid practical exercise before the 30-day trial. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/icarus-digital-marketing-performance-creative-strategist-and-ai-producer

title: IT Administrator - AI & Cybersecurity
description:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team

Our Corporate teams support the company’s performance and growth whilst putting people at the core of everything they do. As a French tech leader and global successful company, our Corporate teams are constantly looking for ways to innovate and increase organization efficiency to keep Voodoo ahead of the market. Voodoo’s Corporate function is composed of three teams: HR, Legal and Finance, working together to drive Voodoo’s success.

Role

We're looking for an IT Administrator - AI & Cybersecurity to join our Corporate team. In this role, you'll own the intersection of IT operations, cybersecurity and AI platform administration, reporting directly to the IT Manager.

IT & SaaS Administration

  • Administer the core SaaS stack - Okta (SSO, SCIM, lifecycle, policies), Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, GitHub Enterprise Cloud and 100+ applications across multiple legal entities

  • Own the MDM estate (Jamf and Intune) across macOS, iOS and Windows: enrolment, compliance baselines, patching and disk encryption

  • Act as the L2/L3 escalation point for internal support, handling endpoint, identity and SaaS incidents that L1 cannot resolve

  • Automate manual run work through scripting, APIs and AI agents where they genuinely add value

Cybersecurity

  • Drive the identity hardening roadmap: session lifetimes, adaptive and phishing-resistant MFA, privileged access management and admin role reviews

  • Own OAuth and third-party app governance across Google Workspace and Okta: inventory, risk-scoring and approval workflows

  • Control SaaS data exposure - publicly and externally shared files, orphaned shares - and build the tooling to support it

  • Contribute to the ZTNA rollout, geo-based access controls and detection & response alongside the SOC and SIEM

AI Platform Administration

  • Administer enterprise AI platforms (Claude, Google Gemini & Vertex AI, OpenAI and others): tenants, SSO, licences, usage analytics and budget control

  • Strengthen the AI governance framework: acceptable-use rules, data classification boundaries, DLP and logging - and detect shadow AI usage

  • Administer connectors, MCP servers and agent integrations

Profile

  • 5+ years of experience in IT administration, infrastructure or IT security in a fast-moving, multi-geography environment

  • Deep hands-on expertise with IdP administration - Okta strongly preferred - and Google Workspace at enterprise scale

  • Solid MDM experience across macOS and Windows (Jamf and/or Intune)

  • Demonstrable cybersecurity practice: IAM hardening, SaaS security posture management, OAuth risk and incident response - you have shipped security work, not just studied it

  • Automation is a reflex: proficiency in scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell) and working with REST APIs and workflow tools

  • Practical experience with enterprise AI platforms and a genuine understanding of the risks introduced by models, agents and connectors accessing corporate data

  • Able to communicate security trade-offs clearly to executives and technical workarounds to developers

  • Fluent English is required, French is a plus

  • Nice to have: security certifications (Security+, CISSP, Okta Certified), ZTNA/SASE or SSPM exposure, cloud IAM on GCP or AWS, ITSM platform experience

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on experience

  • Swile Lunch voucher

  • Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)

  • Premium healthcare coverage with SideCare, 100% covered for you and your family

  • Wellness activities in our Paris office

  • Remote Fridays

title: Compliance Operations Specialist
Compliance Operations Specialist 1
Enterprise Sales Executive, AI Solutions
description: About Toptal Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce . We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold. Job Summary: As an Enterprise Sales Executive at Toptal, you will be a key driver of growth within our AI Solutions business. In this role, you will identify, develop, and close opportunities with enterprise clients by helping them solve complex business challenges through forward-deployed AI solutions, AI software and platforms, AI services, and AI-enabled transformation. You will develop tailored solutions that help clients move from AI strategy and experimentation into production, combining Toptal’s capabilities across AI Strategy & Transformation, Agentic Solutions, Data Services, AI Platforms, Industry Solutions, Joint Partner Solutions, and Managed Services to achieve measurable business outcomes. This role is designed for true hunters who thrive in a high-performance, client-facing environment. It is ideal for individuals who have successfully sold enterprise AI solutions and are passionate about building a book of business from the ground up, forging executive relationships, and creating long-term client value. Success in this role is measured by your ability to convert new enterprise relationships into durable revenue and establish Toptal as a core AI services provider embedded in your clients’ most critical initiatives. Enterprise AI has shifted rapidly from experimentation to execution. Companies are investing in models, agents, AI platforms, data infrastructure, and AI-enabled applications, but many are struggling to translate those investments into production systems and measurable business outcomes. The challenge is no longer simply selecting an AI model or platform. Enterprises must identify the right workflows, connect AI to their proprietary data and knowledge, integrate existing systems, build and deploy agents and applications, establish evaluation and control frameworks, drive adoption, and continuously operate and improve AI in production. Toptal brings together world-class AI and domain talent, forward-deployed solution delivery, AI platforms and capabilities, strategic technology partners, expert-in-the-loop operations, and managed services to help enterprises move from AI promise to production. This role exists to convert that market opportunity into new enterprise relationships and position Toptal as a strategic partner for companies deploying AI across their organizations. This is a remote position with significant client-facing fieldwork across the US. Applicants who reside within commutable distance of a major metropolitan area are strongly preferred. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. Responsibilities: *The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. You will be responsible for building a targeted portfolio of accounts via identifying, prioritizing, and developing your own book of business rather than inheriting an existing one. Once you have signed net new customers, you will partner with Client Partners to deepen and expand those strategic relationships over time. Net new accounts may begin with a specific AI initiative, workflow, platform implementation, or business problem requiring a disciplined approach to defining the opportunity and matching the right Toptal capabilities to the client’s needs. title: Operations Strategy Associate
description:
About Clipboard

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.


Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

 

Overview

The Operations Strategy Associate role is a generalist role at Clipboard suited for the “all-around athlete” type who wants exposure to a range of problems and opportunities.

You’re likely someone who’s interested in and capable of solving different problem types, you’re resourceful, adaptable, and confident you can figure it out if you can sink your teeth in deep enough. These are the ingredients for a problem-solver who is eager to flex into multiple different types of roles and responsibilities depending on what’s needed and most impactful.

While we know that you'll likely start working within one of our Operations teams, we don’t know exactly what work or projects you’ll drive out of the gate, so you’ll notice the work we’re advertising isn’t entirely specific. Some candidates may begin in more execution-focused roles within Operations, depending on their strengths, while others may take on project or team leadership earlier on.

But we’ll make a few promises about the role: it will be high-impact, fast-paced work that directly affects our customers, product, and business.

 

What you’ll Be Doing

  • Analyze operational data to spot trends and bottlenecks, and build dashboards, reports, and models that guide business decisions.

  • Research, evaluate, and implement new technologies, including AI, automations, and internal tools, to make operations more effective.

  • Design processes, workflows, and operating procedures that improve efficiency, quality, and customer experience

  • Lead cross-functional projects and strategic initiatives from planning through execution, partnering with Operations, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and other teams.

Here are a few projects you might own:

  • Redesign how we reach out to workplaces about switching payment methods, such as moving check-paying customers to eCheck, to speed up cash collection.

  • Research, vet, and onboard a vendor that brings AI agents into our customer-facing operations.

  • Build a predictive model that flags high-risk payers early and accurately, so we can act before payments go overdue.

  • Take over a team of agents within one of our Operations teams and improve its performance, quality, and workflows.

 

What you’ll Need

  • 2+ years of work or internship experience, including but not limited to cross-functional roles such as Strategy/Business/Product Operations, Program Management, Consultancy or Business Analytics.

  • Experience solving operational problems by improving processes, designing workflows, or building scalable systems, while juggling multiple priorities in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

  • Strong data analysis skills with hands-on experience in SQL, Python, or similar tools.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex problems simply and align stakeholders across teams.

  • A deep curiosity that drives you to reason from first principles and dig until you find the root cause.

  • The habit of rolling up your sleeves and going to the source. You don't just take someone's word for it; you find out for yourself by testing the feature, listening to the agent call, calling the customer, or running the workflow.

 

We are hiring for multiple openings in this role and won’t close the funnel prematurely based on other candidates, but may periodically pause applications due to volume. We hope to welcome everyone who meets our bar for excellence, and we hope that includes you.

 

Why Join Clipboard?

  • We are remote-first, giving you the flexibility to work with us from many places.

  • Fast-paced startup environment. Join a company that values curiosity, independence, and growth.

  • A hiring process that rewards skills, not just experience. Every applicant gets a fair shot, our selection is based on real-world problem-solving ability, not just credentials.

  • Opportunity to make a significant impact with our customers on both sides of the marketplace.

     

Hiring Process

  1. Application

  2. Case Study

  3. Case Interview(s) with our Operations Leaders

  4. Interview with our Head of Operations

  5. Interview with one of our Co-CEOs

*After submitting your application, please check your spam folder periodically over the next few days for updates.

 

Quick Note on Scammers:

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here.

title: Operations & Automation Associate
description:
About Nous

Nous is an AI agent that takes some of the load of life; making good decisions and acting for our users in areas where they’re not the experts or aren’t paying enough attention. We've started with optimising bills, where we're already saving households thousands, and are now expanding into new categories. Similar to how Amazon picked books as its first category and grew from there.

We’re growing fast, and it's working. 20x YoY growth makes us one of the fastest scaling startups in the UK. And NPS of +70 (higher than Apple) shows that our users love it.

We've just launched two more novel new products (on top of our existing bill optimisation). Insurance: we're the first to get the regulatory approval and build the tech to actually do the full insurance discovery and purchase journey as an agent for the user (not just give them a link to the best deal). Subscription management: lots of companies use Open Banking to draw pretty graphs – we're the first to use it to actively save people money starting by cancelling unwanted subscriptions for them.

It would be easy to look at this and think we've got it all figured out. But we've only scratched the surface; our ambitions are SO much higher.

We’re building a new category of product which is hard, so we’ve stacked the deck in our favour: an experienced founding team with multiple exits, and investors including the founders of Monzo, Wise, Booking.com, lastminute.com, Onfido, Funding Circle, Tide, Habito and more.

Still - the problems we’re solving are hard. ‘Talk is cheap’ applies to agents too. To have REAL impact, agents need to break out of the sandbox and take action in the real world where there are consequences. This means solving all the hard, thorny, interesting, frustrating problems the real world has to offer.

The role

What Nous does for members can feel simple: helping them understand their bills, save money, and avoid admin. But delivering that reliably at scale is complex. This role is about improving the systems behind the scenes, the workflows, tools, automations and processes that help us serve members well as we grow.

That’s where you come in. You’ll join the Operations team at the heart of the business — close enough to our members to understand what is really happening, and technical enough in mindset to help redesign how the operation works as we scale.

This is not a traditional customer operations role. You will spend some of your time close to the frontline, supporting members, understanding tickets and conversations, and seeing where our systems work brilliantly or fall short. That context matters. We believe the best operational systems are built by people who understand the customer experience in detail, not from a distance.

But the core of the role is helping us build the next version of operations at Nous. You’ll identify repeated work, spot failure modes, turn messy processes into clear procedures, and own automations end to end. You’ll help us move work out of inboxes and manual processes, and into better systems, workflows, tooling and AI-assisted operations.

Some days you’ll be digging into a broken process to understand the root cause. Some days you’ll be designing a better workflow, writing a clear operating procedure, or using AI and internal tools to automate work that used to be manual. Other days you’ll be working with product, engineering, data and experienced operators to improve the journeys our members go through and the systems that support them.

You do not need to arrive as a software engineer. But you do need to be unusually quick to pick up technical tools, excited by AI, and willing to get under the bonnet of how things work. You’ll be expected to learn fast, experiment intelligently, and become someone the team trusts to take a messy operational problem and turn it into something robust, repeatable and scalable.

It’s a rare chance to sit at the intersection of operations, product, systems, AI and customer experience inside a very high-growth company. You’ll see how the business really works, build things that materially change how the team operates, and help create the operating model that lets Nous scale from hundreds of thousands of households to millions.

About you

You’re smart, curious, ambitious and unusually high-agency. You want to understand how great companies really work from the inside out, and you’re excited by the idea of helping build one while it is still moving incredibly fast.

You are probably not a software engineer, and you do not need to be. But you are technically curious. You are the kind of person who starts using new tools before they are formally handed to you, who experiments with AI to make yourself more effective, and who enjoys figuring out how systems, workflows and processes actually work.

What makes you exceptional is that you combine operational judgement with a builder’s mindset. You are happy to get close to the detail, including customer conversations and frontline work, because you know that is where the truth usually lives. But you do not want to spend your career just doing the same manual work faster. You want to understand the pattern, fix the process, and build the system that means the work gets done better next time.

You’ll thrive here if you:

  • Have 2–5 years’ experience in operations, consulting, product operations, customer operations, startups, process improvement, or another fast-moving environment

  • Have made extensive use of AI tools in your work, or are clearly on the path to doing so

  • Are excited by the idea of owning automations and operational workflows end to end

  • Learn new tools quickly and are not intimidated by technical systems, internal tooling or messy operational data

  • Have a forensic eye for detail and enjoy tracing problems back to their root cause

  • Can turn ambiguous, messy work into clear processes, documentation and repeatable systems

  • Are naturally empathetic and understand why staying close to customers matters

  • Communicate crisply, whether you’re writing a process, explaining a problem in Slack, or helping a colleague understand a new workflow

  • Work effectively in high-ambiguity, high-growth environments where priorities can shift fast

  • Take ownership without needing lots of structure, and are motivated by making the team around you more effective

  • Want to help build the company you want to work in, not just do the job in front of you

This role is ideal for someone with a few years of experience who has already shown they can take ownership, learn fast and improve the systems around them.Lots of companies will tell you you’ll be “close to the action”. Few can offer the chance to help design the operating system of a company scaling this quickly.

title: AI Response Analyst
description:
The work

iMerit, an EXL company, is looking for detail oriented analysts to evaluate and rank AI generated responses to image based prompts. You will judge answers on accuracy, relevance, clarity, conciseness, safety, localization, and how well they follow the user's instructions, then explain your reasoning in writing.

Much of the job comes down to this: look at the image, look at what the model said about it, and decide whether the two actually match.

What you will do

  • Review images alongside the prompts and responses attached to them

  • Interpret both visual and conversational context before scoring anything

  • Compare multiple responses and rank them against defined criteria

  • Confirm that descriptions and claims about an image reflect what is actually there

  • Verify factual claims using approved research sources

  • Flag tasks that cannot be reliably evaluated

  • Write clear justification for every ranking you submit

What you bring

  • A sharp eye for visual detail and the patience to look twice

  • Strong critical thinking, research skills, and reading comprehension

  • Sound judgment and well supported decision making

  • Professional written English, including the ability to describe what you see precisely

  • The consistency to apply detailed guidelines the same way, task after task

  • Experience in image annotation, content review, editing, research, design, or localization is welcome but not essential.

Good to know
